prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1376; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the details of the accident, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine, we'll get to the details shortly. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved?

A: Yes, I was driving my own car.

Q: Where did the collision happen?

A: On a main road in Baytown, Texas. I was in the right lane getting ready to move over to the left so I could make my exit.

Q: What were you doing right before impact?

A: I checked my mirror, saw the lane was clear, and started to change lanes. Then I felt a bump on my side and heard scraping. The other car had come up in my blind spot.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?

A: I looked, but I didn't see it in the mirror. It must have been right beside me.

Q: Did you or the other driver stop afterward?

A: We both pulled onto the shoulder. We exchanged information and talked for a few minutes.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to urgent care the same day. My lower back was stiff and sore, and they said it looked like a muscle strain.

Q: Are you still having symptoms?

A: Yes, I have pain when I bend or sit for long periods. I've been doing some stretching and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm just hoping to get my car repaired and my back feeling better.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
